lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeInSi crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4mm (No. 119), with a 6-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all three elements: Ce and In are each surrounded by four Si neighbors, while Si is coordinated by two Ce and two In, with neighbor distances ranging from 2.8372 to 2.9575 Å. These tetrahedra connect through corner- and edge-sharing contacts, forming a 3-dimensional periodic network.
